trigger_condition: Activation invokes focus and visibility transitions before silent account lookup resolves.
guard_snippet: After account lookup settles or changes accounts, invoke windowFocused if focused and queueViewed if visible; test persisted pending alerts at startup.
potential_consequence: Pending alerts await a later poll/focus change; the visible queue can retain newSignal.

location: spec-2-1-get-one-useful-alert-for-a-new-request.md — Shared delivery helper; Story 2.2 reminder invariants
trigger_condition: A focused failure encounters pending backlogAlert: delivery after any result conflicts with failures never touching it.
guard_snippet: Choose whether failure-time delivery is allowed; align helper, invariant and focused-failure tests.
potential_consequence: Implementers must violate one of the two required behaviors.

trigger_condition: Repeated incomplete successes before the first complete success can repeatedly satisfy the baseline predicate.
guard_snippet: Define first connection as result.ok && result.complete && previous.lastSuccessAt === undefined; specify partial-baseline handling.
potential_consequence: Incomplete checks can repeatedly re-arm first-connection alerts outside the daily limit.

trigger_condition: A day-D pending reminder delivers on D+1, then another eligible startup on D+1 sees the recorded date D.
guard_snippet: Specify delivery-day accounting, pass today to focus delivery if needed, and test midnight then startup.
potential_consequence: Two aggregate notifications can appear on one local day.

trigger_condition: An undelivered firstConnection alert crosses midnight and an ongoing success replaces it with firstConnection: false.
guard_snippet: Preserve pending first-connection intent; define reminder-date advancement and test this sequence.
potential_consequence: First-connection effect metadata is overwritten before delivery.

trigger_condition: An ok mutate resolves after rule-1 rejection, rule-4 ignored result or read-only operation; the shell clears the flag.
guard_snippet: Expose whether an eligible success applied and clear the flag only on that outcome.
potential_consequence: A startup reminder is consumed before the intended account's queue is evaluated.

trigger_condition: showMessage throws or rejects after alert: shown has been persisted.
guard_snippet: Specify submission-failure semantics; catch sync/async failures without blocking; decide whether failed submission retries or is consumed.
potential_consequence: The only alert can be permanently lost and a rejection can escape the notifier.

trigger_condition: The active account changes during memento.update; the notifier resolves item-only effects using the current account.
guard_snippet: Bind effect execution to the originating account or carry accountId with the snapshot; test account switch during deferred write.
potential_consequence: The alert is skipped or composed from the wrong partition while its source remains shown.

trigger_condition: Mascot changes without PR-row changes, but QueueView currently refreshes its provider only when rows differ.
guard_snippet: Refresh for status-row presence, label or icon changes; test mascot-only transitions.
potential_consequence: Corgi artwork and text remain stale despite a correct view model.

trigger_condition: Partial errors, revoked sign-in or 50-item scenarios lack reproducible setup or a fixture-build procedure.
guard_snippet: Provide prerequisites and repeatable triggers, including fixture-build steps and their relation to the release artifact.
potential_consequence: Installed-build evidence cannot be completed consistently or compared with the release candidate.

trigger_condition: A review arrives during ten-minute observation with the default fifteen-minute polling interval plus jitter.
guard_snippet: Specify request/check scheduling and observation duration guaranteeing an ordinary eligible poll; distinguish delivery failure from non-noticing.
potential_consequence: Usability evidence measures an alert that had no opportunity to appear.

trigger_condition: Usability records No-go or unresolved fix-before-2.6 issues, but all failures are triaged.
guard_snippet: Require affirmative usability release approval and verified closure of all fix-before-2.6 issues.
potential_consequence: Release preparation proceeds against failed validation or unresolved blocking fixes.

trigger_condition: Packaged icon, preview metadata or README changes after dogfood, but version-bump condition mentions only dogfood code fixes.
guard_snippet: Apply artifact-identity rules to all packaged changes, or explicitly scope same-version guarantees to the final candidate.
potential_consequence: Different VSIX artifacts share 0.1.0, contradicting the tested-bits guarantee.

trigger_condition: Step 1 requires CI on the tagged commit, but step 5 creates the tag.
guard_snippet: Verify CI on the identified release commit, then tag that exact commit; alternatively tag before verification.
potential_consequence: The release procedure blocks or requires improvisation about the verified commit.

trigger_condition: Dynamic endpoints or sensitive values aliased through reason/detail/url evade literal and parameter-name scans.
guard_snippet: Add injected-fetch destination assertions and runtime log tests with sentinel tokens/titles through errors and rejected URLs.
potential_consequence: The privacy guard passes while unapproved network calls or sensitive logs remain possible.

trigger_condition: Two windows read pending state before either window's write becomes visible.
guard_snippet: Serialize read-transition-write across windows, with one owner for notification delivery.
potential_consequence: A stale write restores pending alerts, allowing duplicate notifications after focus changes.

trigger_condition: A focused failure or rule-4 no-op encounters a pending backlog reminder.
guard_snippet: Specify whether delivery bypasses the failure/no-op invariants; guard deliverPending accordingly.
potential_consequence: The unconditional delivery helper changes reminder state despite explicit failure and no-op prohibitions.

trigger_condition: Yesterday's pending reminder is delivered today, followed by another startup today.
guard_snippet: Record the actual delivery date and suppress further aggregate delivery on that date.
potential_consequence: Two aggregate notifications appear on one local day despite the daily limit.

trigger_condition: The first successful ok mutate applies an incomplete startup result.
guard_snippet: Keep startupReminderDue until a complete applied success, or explicitly specify partial-result reminder behavior.
potential_consequence: An empty partial result consumes the startup reminder before existing requests are recovered.

trigger_condition: A new request arrives while the queue is already visible.
guard_snippet: Apply queueViewed after rendering new rows when treeView.visible is already true.
potential_consequence: A viewed request retains the new mascot until another poll or visibility change.

trigger_condition: Task 2 starts just after a poll with the default fifteen-minute interval.
guard_snippet: Set a documented test interval and request timing that guarantees notification delivery during observation.
potential_consequence: The ten-minute session ends before notification delivery, invalidating intrusiveness and noticing measurements.

trigger_condition: Usability results record No-go with all failures triaged.
guard_snippet: Require an affirmative usability release decision and closure of every fix-before-2.6 issue.
potential_consequence: Release preparation proceeds despite failed validation or unresolved release-blocking fixes.
